title: Utility companies promise to spare us from AI’s energy bill
slides: Can utilities really shield your wallet from AI's power drain?
They forecast a 160% electricity demand surge by 2030.
Their solution relies on a resource not yet proven at scale.
Your AI usage cost may still double within two years.
Audit your cloud's energy efficiency now before rates rise.
thread_text:
1. Is your AI usage at risk?

By 2030, utilities forecast a 160% electricity demand surge — and your costs will double within two years.

2. The hidden solution

Their fix depends on a resource not yet proven at scale. Expect disruptions before it’s ready.

3. Who pays the price?

Data centers already consume 1% of global electricity. AI training pushes that toward 10% by 2026.

4. The real bill is coming

As rates rise, cloud providers will pass costs to you — not absorb them. No buffer exists.

5. Audit your cloud energy now

Check your cloud provider’s Power Usage Effectiveness today. If it’s above 1.4, you’re overpaying.
